description: This file contains React components and functions related to attachment tools in the Notesnook editor, including attachment settings, download, preview, and removal functionalities.

methods.name: AttachmentSettings
methods.description: React component that renders attachment settings tools based on editor state and toolbar location.

methods.name: DownloadAttachment
methods.description: React component that triggers download of the selected attachment or image.

methods.name: PreviewAttachment
methods.description: React component that triggers preview of the selected attachment or image if previewable.

methods.name: RemoveAttachment
methods.description: React component that removes the selected attachment.

methods.name: canPreviewAttachment
methods.description: Function that determines if an attachment can be previewed based on its MIME type or file extension.
